Messages.Author: Kevin Mitcham
Messages.Body:
This came up this evening, and I was wondering what was correct.
Vamp A with sup prot is blleding. Vamp B is tapped, but uses wwef to block.
Combat happens; Vamp A uses Form of Mist to continue at +1 stealth; can
vamp B use intercept and try to block again? Ie, does the wwef last til
the action resolves, or until the block attempt results in combat?

Pol the Troll

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Wakey lasts until the action is concluded, by explicit card text.

Vamp B needs only one more intercept to re-block Vamp A.
